limits._comment: Desktop transfer caps are regression limits just above current cold-load medians (EN 202.51 KB; AR 232.33 KB), not performance goals. Both desktop goals remain 200000 bytes; both mobile profiles enforce 200000 bytes. JavaScript enforces 90000 bytes gzip, with 50000 bytes retained as the goal in performance-goals.json.

conditions: Conservative static cold-load estimate: compressed HTML/current copy, inline and linked CSS, entry static JS graph, both required fonts in Arabic, portrait and MASR responsive images at DPR 1, 1000-byte response allowance. Runtime Lighthouse separately measures actual transfers.
